gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o1 -> i1: Tests to verify that it is possibly to merge {@link JsonIncludeProperties.Value} instances for overrides

ADDED i2: Sample annotated type: includes "foo" and "bar", order left at default.
ADDED i3: Sample annotated type that also requests ordered inclusion.
ADDED i4: Shared "include everything" value (null included set, null ordered flag).
ADDED i5: from(null) must hand back the shared ALL singleton
ADDED i6: ALL means "no explicit included set" and "no ordering preference"
ADDED i7: The annotation's value() {"foo", "bar"} becomes the included set; no ordering flag
ADDED i8: toString contains the set, whose iteration order is not guaranteed
ADDED i9: Two values built from the same annotation are equal
ADDED i11: Overriding with ALL (undefined included set) leaves the original untouched
ADDED i12: Overriding with an empty set keeps only the intersection: nothing
ADDED i13: Override of {"foo"} intersects with {"foo", "bar"} to leave just {"foo"}
ADDED i14: order = TRUE on the annotation surfaces as getOrdered() == Boolean.TRUE
ADDED i15: Different included sets must produce different values and hash codes
ADDED i16: Same included set, varying ordered flag (TRUE / FALSE / TRUE / null)
ADDED i17: The ordered flag participates in equality
ADDED i18: Identical included set and ordered flag are equal
ADDED i19: Builds a Value from the @JsonIncludeProperties annotation declared on the given type.
ADDED i20: Order-preserving set, used so expected/actual comparisons are easy to read.
